newsitem.title: GERMANY: Metro not to bid on Kaufhalle.
newsitem.headline: Metro not to bid on Kaufhalle.

text.p: German retailing group Metro AG will make no offer to minority shareholders in Kaufhalle AG, chairman Wolfgang Urban said on Wednesday.
Chief executive Klaus Wiegandt also said the stock was not undervalued, but that a 20 percent rise in three days shows that the market's hopes are too high.

Urban told the company's annual general meeting that about 25 percent of Kaufhalle's shares were on the open market, but that Metro planned no offer and that shareholders would not receive a dividend for 1996 due to poor business results.
Wiegandt warned against excessive stock market expectations in connection with the planned purchase of SHV Holdings NV/Makro of Holland.
Supervisory board chairman Erwin Conradi said the talks with SHV were expected to succeed, but were still in early stages.
